name: Communist Party of India
role: Communist Political Party in Colonial and Postcolonial India
contribution: The Communist Party of India shaped Bengal left politics through labour, peasant, anti-fascist, and Tebhaga-era organizing, and remained a major reference point in partition-era left debates.
context: Late-colonial Bengal, peasant sharecropping struggles, labour politics, and communist participation in constitutional transition debates.
impact: Its Bengal networks helped make class, land, and peasant rights central to twentieth-century political mobilization across the region.
highlight: A major left party behind labour and peasant mobilization, including the Tebhaga-era politics of Bengal.
seoTitle: Communist Party of India - Bengal Left Politics Profile
seoDescription: Profile of the Communist Party of India and its Bengal connections through Tebhaga, labour politics, peasant mobilization, and partition-era debates.
shortAnswer: The Communist Party of India was a major left party connected to Tebhaga, Bengal labour politics, and partition-era communist debates.

faq.question: How is the Communist Party of India linked to Bengal history?
faq.answer: The CPI was tied to labour and peasant organization in Bengal, including Tebhaga-era mobilization and left debates around partition and constitutional transition.
